freedom.text: How much freedom does the agent have to decide alone?

options.label: It does routine work alone
options.detail: reading and repeated tasks; it asks about the rest

options.label: It decides alone inside the limits
options.detail: every write still asks for your permission

options.label: Also at night
options.detail: it may work while you are away

options.label: In a chain
options.detail: the work passes from one to the next in order

work_sensitivity.text: How sensitive is the work on this network?

options.label: Confidential
options.detail: does not leave your network: cloud accesses are removed
